name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: The Bloodmaster's Ring challenge sends you against Buzzbeak for a chance at fame. The ring's goblin expects the fight to be easy.

sections.title: Into the Ring
sections.body: The ring's goblin puts Buzzbeak before you in the ring. You are told this first fight should be easy, though the fiend is said to bring down its foe and take their belongings. Fame is promised to those who enter.

faq.q: Who do I fight in the Bloodmaster's Ring?
faq.answer: You face Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

faq.q: What is Buzzbeak supposed to do?
faq.answer: Buzzbeak is described as a flighty fiend that can bring you down and take your belongings.
The ring's goblin promises fame for entering the ring.

faq.q: Is this fight meant to be easy?
faq.answer: The ring's goblin presents this as an easy first fight.
